_comment: Graphics Image Protocol (GIP) prompt bands, version 3 (owner order 2026-10-05, KIE prompt rule 12). A band is a QUALITY profile per asset class: tier, distinct-word density floor, whether baked text is allowed, applies_to and the routing endpoints. A band holds NO length numbers. Prompt LENGTH is KIE rule 12 (95 to 100 percent of the model's maxLength, hard floor 80 percent, hard ceiling 100 percent), enforced by shared-utils/kie_prompt_enforcer.py, which wraps 74-kie-live-adapter kie_live_adapter.py prompt-budget --check (live schema, registry fallback). diu_validator.py prompt-band checks the length against --model (default: the first endpoint of the band) and rejects below the floor (AF-GIP-PROMPT-FLOOR, prints the characters to add) or above the max (AF-DIU-PROMPT-CAP, prints the characters to cut). A band's 'endpoints' list is the AUTHORITATIVE routing guidance role docs must follow (GK-20): an endpoint refused for text everywhere else (Skill 35 pregen_prompt_gate.py non-text models) never appears in a text_bearing:true band. Ideogram V3 is not a social route; it stays only on the non-social `medium` specialty band below. Enforced by 45-design-intelligence-library/scripts/diu_validator.py prompt-band and SOP-GIP-01.

applies_to: social post graphic with baked text
text_bearing_long._rationale: Text-bearing assets (ads, covers, infographics, and social posts with baked text) route to GPT Image 2.5, the strongest on long structured prompts (MODEL-SPECS section 4). Social text-led posts no longer have a separate Ideogram band: Skill 35 routes every social image to GPT Image 2.5 Sunburst (owner order 2026-10-05). GK-20: nano-banana-2 is NOT an endpoint of any text-bearing band.

medium._rationale: Non-social specialty route. Seedream hard-fails silently above its own maxLength (MODEL-SPECS:14; SOP-DIU-615:77); the limit and the 80 percent floor now come from the model's live schema through the shared enforcer.

short_draft._rationale: SHORT exists for drafts and ideation only; a SHORT-tier output is NEVER a client deliverable. Any draft that is sent to a KIE model is still checked against rule 12 for that model.
